name: mobile-header-budget
goal: Preserve 40-pixel mobile search targets inside the existing 184-pixel header budget.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The committed 01bcfc78f browser run passed 200 cases and failed the existing mobile header limit: 190px exceeds 184px. Preserve 40px search/settings targets, all seven category labels, revision controls and project/context breathing room.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: 54e2967bd enlarged both mobile category rows from 34px to 40px. Its focused search matrix checked target size and overlap but omitted the existing overall-height invariant in ui-workspace. Add that bound to the same eight-width matrix, retain the workspace case, and record exact-source screenshots before assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 5414b5e89 immutable red 9d1c9eb8 records the header exceeding the 184px bound. The unchanged search and workspace suites run against a stamped compiled snapshot; 20 real NavBar fixture captures are retained in Harness before cleanup.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Remove the mobile grid gaps that add six pixels across the header bands. Retain both 40px category rows, search/settings dimensions and the 88px tool column; the existing workspace case also enforces project/context breathing room.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: The mobile grid uses zero inter-band gap, retaining 40px category rows and search/settings targets. The normal eight-width search matrix now enforces the existing 184px mobile header bound; catalog banner scope excludes the search dialog banner.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 8d5c74e84 passes the same compiled search/workspace command: 21 cases, 24 source-bound NavBar captures. Proof 4ef943bd retains the unchanged e2ff5dfbf regression corpus and paired red 9e849c9b. Inspected 320px and 390px original pixels.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Fresh isolated recurrence rejects unfixed e2ff5dfbf with proof c3db48ce and 20 captures, then passes repaired 8d5c74e84 with proof 7f825d85 and 24 captures. Both phases use the same command, frozen inputs and environment. Broader verification remains pending.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
